definitions: A decorative border of hanging threads or cords.
The front part of a person's hair cut so that it hangs over the forehead.
The outer edge or margin of an area, group, or activity.
An unconventional or extreme part of a group.
examples: A rug with a silk fringe.
She decided to cut a fringe.
Living on the fringe of the city.
The radical fringe of the party.
